Type: table
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Coastal Breeze Rustic Farmhouse Coffee Table, 55.1"W, Natural and White
Colors: White & Wood
Materials: wood
Bring a relaxing coastal feel into your home with the simple beauty of this coffee table. A top of recycled elm is paired with a poplar wood base and given a distressed white painted finish. This piece also blends with modern farmhouse décor. 55.1”W x 31.5”D x 16.1”H Reclaimed elm top on base of poplar wood Rustic wood makes this table work with coastal or modern farmhouse style A beautifully simple table great for magazines or snack trays Assembly required. Wipe with soft dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
